chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
while he was holding the hand of Ali (peace be upon him): 'Whoever claims that he loves me but does not love this one has lied.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Prophet holding Ali's hand in this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith utilizes the physical gesture of holding Ali’s hand to emphasize the tangible and inseparable nature of *Mawaddah* (affection) for the Ahl al-Bayt as a condition of true prophetic love. It serves as a foundational proof in Shia theology that love for Ali is not merely an emotional preference but a theological necessity for validating one's claim to follow the Prophet.
